Question Choices: How many sides does a quadrilateral have?
Solution: 4 sides.   -> The word quad means four. A quadrilateral is any shape that has four sides

Question Choices: Which shape is a quadrilateral?  (A) Triangle (B) Rectangle (C) Pentagon
Solution: Triangle: 3 sides. Rectangle: 4 sides. Pentagon: 5 sides. A quadrilateral is any shape that has four sides

Question Choices: Is a square a quadrilateral? Answer yes or no
Hints: Count the sides of a square.
Solution: Yes. A square has 4 sides, so it is a quadrilateral.

Question Choices: What is special about a parallelogram? (A) Opposite sides are parallel   (B) All sides are curved  (C) It has 3 sides
Hints: Think about sides going the same direction.
Solution: A parallelogram is a quadrilateral where opposite sides are parallel (going the same direction).

Question Choices: If lines would never cross even if extended, what do we call them?
Solution: Parallel    -> Parallel lines go in the same direction and never cross.

Question Choices: What makes a rhombus special?  (A) All sides are equal  (B) Only two sides are equal  (C) No sides are equal
Solution: A    -> A rhombus has all four sides the same length.

Question Choices: Is every rhombus also a quadrilateral? Answer yes or no
Hints: Think about the properties of rhombus and quadrilateral
Solution: Yes   -> A quadrilateral is any shape that has four sides. A rhombus has 4 sides, so it is always a quadrilateral.

Question Choices: If two opposite sides of a shape are parallel and the other two are also parallel, what shape could it be?
Solution: When both pairs of opposite sides are parallel, the shape is a parallelogram. Square and Rectangle are special case of parallelogram

Question Choices: Is a square also a rectangle? Answer yes or no
Solution: Yes   -> A square has: 4 right angles and 4 equal sides. So a square is both a rectangle and a rhombus.

Question Choices: A shape has 4 right angles. What shape could it be?
Solution: Both rectangles and squares have four right angles.

Question Choices: A shape has 4 sides and all sides are equal. What shape could it be?
Solution: A rhombus is a quadrilateral where all four sides are equal. A suqare is a special case of rhombus
